capabilities: Copy the entire note to the clipboard via a header button
Run a Copy entire note command from the palette or hotkeys
Optionally include frontmatter or prepend the filename as an H1
Configure the header icon, notices, and button visibility
Add the command to the mobile toolbar on Obsidian 1.13.7
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer on desktop or mobile; tested only on macOS and a physical iPhone. Falls back to a temporary off-screen textarea when the Clipboard API is unavailable or rejects the request. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click way to copy an entire note's current Markdown, including unsaved buffer edits, for pasting elsewhere.
summary: Header button and command that copy the open note's full Markdown, including unsaved edits, straight to the clipboard.
